text: @uachar/dsh-ui-chime 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的浏览器提示音插件，通过客户端会话事件与待处理交互状态，在一轮对话完成、模型等待审批或等待用户选择时播放合成提示音。它使用 Web Audio 生成音效，并在输入框工具行提供喇叭按钮和音量滑块，调节时可试听，音量保存在浏览器 localStorage。插件也会过滤历史回放，并在子代理仍运行时抑制主回合结束提示。适合希望及时注意到 DSH 需要回应或已完成工作的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。浏览器需先有一次用户操作才能解除音频自动播放限制。

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime adds browser chimes to DSH web when a turn finishes or awaits input. Web Audio generates the sound; a composer slider previews and adjusts volume saved in localStorage. History replay stays silent, and turn-end chimes wait for child agents. No key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 每轮回答完成后响一声提醒我。
DSH 等我批准操作或选择答案时能不能发出提示音？
Can I get an audible cue when a DSH turn finishes or waits for my input?
@uachar/dsh-ui-chime 的功能「对话边界提示音」：在实时回合完成时播放合成音，也会在当前会话出现待审批或待回答问题时提示；历史事件回放不会触发，子代理仍运行时不提示回合结束。
@uachar/dsh-ui-chime 的功能「音量调节与试听」：输入框工具行的喇叭按钮可展开音量滑块，拖动时播放对应音量的试听音；音量写入浏览器 localStorage，刷新后继续使用。

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · @uachar/dsh-ui-chime：A browser chime plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**: a short synthesized "ding" plays when the model reaches a boundary you care about — a completed turn, or a point where it is waiting for you. No audio assets, no session-log writes, no changes to the dsh core; installed as a standalone package.

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · Features：- Rings when **a full turn completes** (`turn/end` with `completed` / `max-tokens`) — the intermediate thinking phases of multi-step turns stay silent.
- Rings when **an approval is requested** (`approval/asked`) — the model is waiting on a permission decision.
- Rings when **the model calls `ask_user_question`** (`tool/call`) — it is waiting for you to pick an option.
- **Volume control** with instant preview; setting persists across sessions.
- Synthesized with Web Audio (oscillators + gain envelope) — **zero audio files**, no added asset weight.
- History replay (opening a session, pagination, reconnect) never rings: an event counts as live only if it is within 10 seconds of now.

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · How to use：- **Volume control**: the composer tool row has a speaker button (Windows-style line icon) on the left; click it to open a slider. **Dragging the slider plays a preview chime at the new volume**, so you can hear the level as you adjust. The setting persists in `localStorage` (`dsh.ui-chime.volume`).
- **Autoplay policy**: browsers keep `AudioContext` suspended until the first user gesture, so the chime is silent before the page has been clicked once — click anywhere and it works afterwards.
@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · Installation & removal：> Requires a working `dsh` CLI (pnpm) and a profile, e.g. `web`.

section: Install from the GitHub release tarball

text:
@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · Build & install from source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/uAcharGG/dsh-ui-chime.git
cd dsh-ui-chime
pnpm install
pnpm run build        # tsc -> tsdown; emits lib/index.js and lib/client.js

Restart `dsh` after any install to take effect.

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · Removal：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @uachar/dsh-ui-chime
```

Then restart `dsh`. (Enable/disable via the manager panel only edits the composition layer without removing the code.)

@uachar/dsh-ui-chime README · Project structure：| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle composition layer: inserts the plugin as one `ui-chime` row |
| `src/index.ts` | host half: empty apply (so the row appears in the Host loader / `dsh.client` scan) |
| `src/client/index.ts` | browser half: headless Conversation Definition (ring triggers) + volume control registration |
| `src/client/chime.ts` | Web Audio synthesis engine + persisted volume |
| `src/client/volume-control.tsx` | speaker button and volume slider in the composer tool row |
| `lib/` | build output (published) |
